payload.title: Pin the claim-check workflow's CLI version instead of @latest
payload.body: tasks-claim-check.yml installs @tasks-md/cli@latest into a temp dir each run (line ~50). Now that claim-check is a REQUIRED (blocking) gate, @latest is a liability: (a) a just-published version not yet propagated to the npm mirror makes the install fail -> check fails -> ALL PRs blocked (fail-closed brittleness); (b) supply-chain — @latest auto-pulls any new release. Pin to a known-good exact version (e.g. the current published 0.10.x) and bump it deliberately when check-push changes. Trade-off: a version-bump step when check-push evolves. Surfaced reviewing the armed enforcement workflow.
